notes: Auto-spread fills the earliest open weekdays. A far stop stays on its own day. Booked stops show on the day preview.
Back To Queue on Missed Stops returns a blowout to the winterization queue with a Missed date tag. The next Auto-spread places it with the other open stops.
Header Back says Back on every screen and returns to the previous screen. With no earlier screen it opens the parent page.
Not Now hides that On Location card until the phone is more than 200 m away and comes back, or for 4 hours. Home Location under Route and Scheduling hides On Location within about 150 m of home.
